full_name: Visual Impairment as a Risk for Falls Questionnaire
domains: last eye exam and spectacle use (A-C); eyesight items on interocular difference, reading, side vision, steps/curbs, face recognition, television, tripping (1-7)
scoring: Yes (Q5 No) on any question = positive for that impairment; aggregate = any positive of Q1-Q7
target_population: adults over 65, for use by non-eye-care health professionals in falls prevention clinics
notes: Items 2-6 adapted from NEI VFQ-25; 3 preliminary questions A-C plus 7 scored questions (Figure 1 p2)
